semantic.justification: Task184 implements the pinned RTL decimal lexer and normalized-to-original offset map with JS Number only for a recognized decimal prefix. Preserve ASCII space/tab,sign,group separators,legacy INF/NAN,partial exponent,no-conversion,status and rounded legacy DBL_MAX behavior. Typed-array views adapt native pointer ranges without allocation/refcount simulation. Native QA and independent binary64 ties/subnormal boundaries verify represented values;NaN payload/physical ABI and other RTL numeric APIs are not claimed. SAX read overloads delegate this single shared owner;no numeric writer/unit overload or complete Calc document/UI/ODS claim.
